title: INTU's Big Bets Keep Scaling: Can These Become Its Main Growth Engine?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Intuit's 'Big Bets' (Assisted Tax, Money, and Mid-Market) represent 30% of fiscal 2026 revenues with over 30% year-over-year growth, significantly outpacing overall company growth of 14%. While the company sees a $300B+ addressable market and leverages AI across 82 million consumers and 10 million businesses, new customer acquisition fell short of expectations in fiscal 2026. Management guides fiscal 2027 revenue growth of 9%-10% while continuing to invest in scaling these growth engines.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong growth in Big Bets segment (30%+ YoY) and significant AI capabilities are positive, but offset by missed new customer growth expectations in fiscal 2026 and modest forward guidance of 9-10% revenue growth for fiscal 2027. Stock trading at discount to industry average P/S ratio but estimates revised downward.

Demonstrating successful AI integration with AI Tax Assist handling 4.1M client messages (up 88%), paired with expert-led services. Fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 4.9% and positive fiscal 2027 guidance of $4.11-4.16B shows steady scaling of technology alongside core business.

Strong fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 17% to $6.51B with successful AI scaling across payroll and HR. WISE product adoption exceeding 50,000 businesses with 90% error correction rate demonstrates effective AI implementation and market traction.

title: LightPath Technologies, Inc. (LPTH) Reports Q4 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
author: Zacks.Com
description: LightPath Technologies reported a Q4 loss of $0.02 per share, matching consensus estimates and improving from a $0.07 loss a year ago. The company beat revenue estimates with $21.16 million in quarterly revenues, up 73% year-over-year. However, LPTH has underperformed the S&P 500 by 17.7% year-to-date and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the company beat revenue estimates and showed significant year-over-year revenue growth (73%), it reported a loss and has underperformed the broader market substantially. The Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and mixed estimate revisions suggest the stock is expected to perform in line with the market, neither presenting a compelling buy nor sell case.

Paychex is expected to report strong quarterly earnings of $1.33 per share, representing 9% year-over-year growth, with revenues expected to reach $1.62 billion, up 5.1% from the prior year. The company demonstrates consistent growth momentum in the payroll and HR services sector.

title: Cognyte Software Ltd. (CGNT) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
author: Zacks.Com
description: Cognyte Software reported Q2 earnings of $0.15 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.09, with a 66.67% earnings surprise. Revenues reached $109.24 million, slightly exceeding estimates. However, the stock has underperformed the market, declining 12.5% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 12.1% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the company delivered strong earnings and revenue beats (66.67% EPS surprise), the stock has significantly underperformed the broader market year-to-date (-12.5% vs S&P 500 +12.1%). The Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and mixed estimate revisions suggest near-term performance in line with the market, not outperformance.

Paychex is expected to report Q1 results with earnings growth of 9% year-over-year and revenue growth of 5.1%. However, consensus EPS estimates have remained unchanged over the last 30 days, indicating stable but not improving expectations.
